propositions.hypotheses: F is C1 on a convex ball; J_star has full column rank; derivative variation epsilon is below its smallest singular value s
propositions.conclusion: (s-epsilon)||a-a_prime|| <= ||F(a)-F(a_prime)||, giving uniqueness and Lipschitz stability on the image
propositions.proof: Integral of the derivative along the segment, singular-value bound, triangle inequality
propositions.exclusions: No existence for every noisy ambient observation; no general least-squares uniqueness; no necessity of full derivative rank

propositions.hypotheses: Known deterministic phi in L2, T>0, x/kappa/sigma known, 1-kappa*T>0, fixed Brownian filtration
propositions.conclusion: The displayed X,Y,Z are the unique S2/S2/H2 solution of dX=(Y+phi^T*a)dt+sigma*dW, dY=Z*dW, Y_T=kappa*X_T
propositions.proof: Explicit product-rule construction; conditional martingale identity determines Y from X; linear SDE uniqueness determines X and martingale representation fixes Z
propositions.exclusions: No arbitrary nonlinear generator theorem; no assertion that current HCSN is this FBSDE

propositions.hypotheses: Exact endpoint means under the explicit family; H rows are time integrals of known phi_j
propositions.conclusion: Global parameter uniqueness iff rank(H)=p; finite noisy endpoints instead give statistical identification when covariance is known and positive definite
propositions.proof: Left inverse or a nonzero null vector; exact Gaussian noise law and direct estimator covariance calculation
propositions.exclusions: Backward terminal relation is redundant with X_T; Z is parameter independent here; varying x alone repeats the same design row

propositions.hypotheses: Common coordinates/objective/contribution set, compatible weights, regularizer counted once, G positive definite, exact arithmetic or separately fixed numerical protocol
propositions.conclusion: Each peer's solve of summed G_i and h_i gives the same centralized quadratic minimizer
propositions.proof: Expand the quadratic and prove the positive-definite Hessian condition through the kernel intersection
propositions.exclusions: No privacy, fault tolerance, liveness, independent users, nonlinear benefit, or learned-representation alignment inferred
